root_cause: src/measurement_gate.m compares d2 against an inlined 5.991 (chi-squared, m = 2, 95 %) instead of the gamma it is passed, so in Doppler mode (m = 4, configured gamma 13.277) about 20 % of good measurements are rejected and the track drifts past the 0.5 m limit.

evidence.quote: estimator-02 mean runtime 19% above other workers

ruled_out: v2.3 covariance regression: kalman_update forms S from the current P every step, and v2.4.1 planar runs pass like the v2.3.2 baseline.
estimator-02: about 19 % slower but under 40 ms against a 50 ms limit; no run failed on runtime and its failure count is not the highest.
Doppler sensor noise or an over-tight limit: rejections match the chi-squared(4) tail beyond 5.991, which a correct R produces; the defect is in the gate.
Configuration: gate.gamma holds the CVT-SRS-003 Rev C Appendix A values and cvt_model passes them to the gate.
